node.statement: For j in G_a, use the split 1=L_j+U_j with U_j=sum_{v:d_v>a*tau} lambda_jv. Then sum_{j in G_a} P_ij^+=sum_{j in G_a} P_ij^+ U_j + sum_{j in G_a} P_ij^+ L_j, and the first term is exactly M_i^a from the root statement. Since P_ij^+>=0, node 1.3 gives sum_{j in G_a} P_ij^+ L_j<=sum_{j in G_a} P_ij^+*(H-d_j)/(H-a*tau). Combining these inequalities proves the displayed bound, and node 1.1 gives the claimed hidden-depth support of M_i^a.
